# megaport_product_availability (Data Source)

Lists the products your company can order and the markets each one is available in. The company is the one the provider credentials act in, which is the managed account when `managed_account_uid` is set. Filter the list with a `for` expression.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List the products the company behind the provider credentials can order.
data "megaport_product_availability" "available" {}

# Variant and market codes for each orderable product.
output "orderable_products" {
  value = [
    for product in data.megaport_product_availability.available.products : {
      variant = product.variant
      markets = [for market in product.markets : market.market]
    } if product.category == "PRODUCT"
  ]
}

# Every add-on the company can order.
output "addons" {
  value = [
    for product in data.megaport_product_availability.available.products :
    product.display_name if product.category == "ADDON"
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `company_uid` (String) The UID of the company the availability applies to.
- `products` (Attributes List) The products the company can order. The API sorts them by category, then variant. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--products))

<a id="nestedatt--products"></a>
### Nested Schema for `products`

Read-Only:

- `category` (String) The product category: `PRODUCT`, `ADDON`, or `BUNDLE`.
- `display_name` (String) The human-readable name of the product.
- `markets` (Attributes List) The markets the company can order the product in. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--products--markets))
- `variant` (String) The specific variant of the product, such as `VXC_TRANSIT` or `PORT`.

<a id="nestedatt--products--markets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `products.markets`

Read-Only:

- `country_code` (String) The short code of the market's country.
- `market` (String) The market code, such as `MEGAPORT_AUSTRALIA`.
- `market_name` (String) The human-readable name of the market.
- `market_owner` (String) The name of the Megaport entity that owns the market.
- `source` (String) Where the availability comes from: `MARKET` (the market default) or `OVERRIDE` (a rule for your company).
